title: The Morning Digest: November 4, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 settled at $103.60 on Tuesday, down $1.17 or 1.12 percent, and WTI Dec26 settled at $96.09, down $0.37 or 0.38 percent (Reuters), after Tehran called the American reply to its seven conditions not convincing and a senior Iranian official said the two sides remain far from a deal. Overnight Brent rose 76 cents to $104.36 and WTI rose 63 cents to $96.72 at 0730 GMT after Democrats captured both chambers of Congress. The API reported a crude draw of 5.267 million barrels for the week ending Oct 30 against surveys centred near flat, and the US inventory report lands today at 10:30 a.m. ET. December WCS is -$31.25 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 3) on 153 lots, December Houston traded at -$23.02 (ICE ARV settle, Nov 3) on 100 lots, and the validated diesel crack is $94.99.

sources.vintage: Nov 3-4, 2026 (Tuesday settles: Brent Jan27 $103.60, down $1.17 or 1.12 percent, lowest close since Oct 7; WTI Dec26 $96.09, down $0.37 or 0.38 percent, lowest close since Oct 14; Brent intraday high $106.61 on the reported Qeshm Island strike; overnight Wednesday Brent $103.34 and WTI $95.56 at 0157 GMT, reversing to Brent $104.36, up 76 cents, and WTI $96.72, up 63 cents, at 0730 GMT after Democrats captured both chambers of Congress; the new Congress is seated Jan 3, 2027)
